newsitem.title: INDIA: Punjab cotton weak, Gujarat firm on stock shortage.
newsitem.headline: Punjab cotton weak, Gujarat firm on stock shortage.

text.p: Punjab cotton varieties were easier on Friday amid thin trade, while Gujarat cotton was firm on a shortage of ready stock despite only scattered mill buying, traders said.
In the spot market Punjab saw-ginned was five rupees lower at 1,820/1,850 per maund (37.32 kg), while Bengal-deshi was down five rupees at 1,000/1,075 per maund.
In the Gujarat segment, wagad cotton rose 100 rupees to 13,000/13,200 per candy (355.56 kg) while Kalyan cotton was up 100 rupees at 14,200/14,700 per candy.
